# F5 API pages

The API added for the PSP track. "yes" in a profile column means the whole page compiles on that profile; "part" means some members are gated (the page shows which). The tables come from `tools/cooker/data/profile_defaults.json`; the profile table is in [api-availability.md](../api-availability.md).

| Page | PSX | PSP | PS2 | What |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Light](Light.md) | yes | yes | yes | A light that shines on lit meshes at run time (Unity: Light). |
| [RenderSettings](RenderSettings.md) | yes | yes | yes | Scene-wide ambient light and distance fog (Unity: RenderSettings). |
| [SkinnedMeshRenderer](SkinnedMeshRenderer.md) | no | yes | yes | Draws a skinned mesh from a glTF file, driven by an Animation on the same object. |
| [Animation](Animation.md) | no | yes | yes | Plays one skeletal clip on the SkinnedMeshRenderer of the same object (Unity: Animation). |
| [Application](Application.md) | part | yes | part | Runtime facts and controls. F5 adds the CPU clock, the system language, the confirm button and the pause event. |
| [TouchScreenKeyboard](TouchScreenKeyboard.md) | part | yes | part | The platform's on-screen keyboard (Unity: TouchScreenKeyboard). |
| [SystemInfo](SystemInfo.md) | part | yes | part | Battery and memory facts (Unity: SystemInfo). |
| [Save](Save.md) | part | yes | part | Saves. F5 adds a mode that uses the platform's own save dialog. |
| [AudioSource](AudioSource.md) | yes | yes | yes | Plays a clip. F5 adds `priority`. |
